paragraphs: The X5 sDrive25d was introduced as the entry-level diesel variant of the F15-generation X5, built from 2013 to 2018. It uses the N47 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel — a widely-used BMW engine family of that era, though notably the only four-cylinder diesel in a generation otherwise dominated by six-cylinder units. The sDrive25d was a rear-wheel-drive-only variant, making it unique within the F15 range where most other diesels were xDrive. The X5 sDrive25d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the X5 sDrive25d from 2013 to 2018. Known for timing chain stretch over time — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, guides, tensioners and gaskets as standard on every N47 rebuild.
